name: Silver Dollar
description: Eucalyptus stems climbing the sheet behind round coin leaves, the coins alternating single and in pairs.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 47.5%, var(--color1) 47.5% 52.5%, transparent 52.5%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, 50%, 26%); top: 50%; width: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, @rn(58, 76, 2)%, 47%); height: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, @rn(58, 76, 2)%, 47%); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: translate(-50%, -50%); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 74%; top: 50%; width: 47%; height: 47%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: translate(-50%, -50%); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); opacity: @match((x + y) % 2 == 0, 0, 1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
